item.title: David Bowie’s “Heroes” Explodes Thanks To Stranger Things | Hit Channel
item.description: Stranger Things did it again. Bowie’s Heroes is back, louder than ever, and Gen Z is hitting repeat like it’s 1977.

item.title: Madonna Covers Patty Pravo’s “La Bambola” | Hit Channel
item.description: Madonna singing in Italian was not on our 2026 bingo card. La bambola is back, couture edition only.

item.title: Bruno Mars Returns With “I Just Might” And The Romantic | Hit Channel
item.description: Bruno Mars is back with smooth vocals and ’70s swagger. His new era starts with “I Just Might,” and trust us—it’s pure groove. 💫

item.title: Robyn Announces New Album “Sexistential” Out March 27 | Hit Channel
item.description: Robyn is back and she’s not playing it safe. New album Sexistential drops March 27 and it’s raw, sensual and fearless. Pop grown-up energy.

item.title: Sean Combs Asks Trump For Pardon, Gets Shut Down | Hit Channel
item.description: Sean Combs tried one last Hail Mary: a letter to Donald Trump asking for a pardon. Trump’s response? Hard no. Power, fame, and politics collide.

item.title: Bono Calls For Barghouti’s Release To Restart Peace | Hit Channel
item.description: Bono goes there. In a powerful essay, the U2 frontman calls for the release of Marwan Barghouti and says peace only happens with enemies, not vibes.

item.title: K-pop’s “Golden” Wins Best Original Song At 2026 Golden Globes | Hit Channel
item.description: : K-pop just took a massive step! 🌟 Ejae’s “Golden” scoops Best Original Song at the 2026 Golden Globes. Dreams do come true.

item.title: Black Midi’s Matt Kwasniewski-Kelvin Dies At 26 | Hit Channel
item.description: A huge loss for experimental music. Black Midi’s founding guitarist Matt Kwasniewski-Kelvin has died at just 26. His impact still echoes.

item.title: David Guetta Ignites HAVEN’s Viral Hit “I Run” Remix | Hit Channel
item.description: From viral chaos to peak-hour glory. David Guetta just gave HAVEN’s “I Run” the remix that turns TikTok energy into full-on club damage. This comeback is loud.

item.title: Flea & Thom Yorke Unite On New Song “Traffic Lights | Hit Channel
item.description: Flea just dropped a jazz-infused track with Thom Yorke and it hits different. “Traffic Lights” is moody, weird, and beautiful.
